Appearance:
MR KI SHAH(766) for the PETITIONER(s) No. 1 MR DK MODI(1317) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1,2,4 MR MD MODI(1318) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1,2,4 MR HARDIK SONI, APP for the RESPONDENT NO.5 ==========================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE B.N. KARIA  Date : 22/04/2018  ORAL ORDER 1.

This Criminal Appeal preferred under Section 378 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is directed against the judgment and order of acquittal dated 26.08.2016 passed by learned Judicial Magistrate, Municipal Court, Surat in PFA Case No. 58 of 2001, acquitting all the respondents for an offence registered against them under the provisions of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
2. This Appeal is taken up for settlement in Lok Adalat.
3. Mr. Hardik Soni, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has appeared on behalf of the State and has produced withdrawal / settlement pursis, which is taken on record.

The withdrawal /
R/CR.A/1009/2017 ORDER settlement pursis is signed by APP Shri Hardik Soni, Food Safety Officer Shri Hemesh S. Patel, for an on behalf of original complainant Shri N.B. Vyas, who has superannuated from the service of the Corporation.

All the concerned are present in person before Narendra Balkrushna Vyas vs Manibhai Mulchanddas Patel on 22 April, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185607876/
1 this Lok Adalat, and the pursis is counter signed by learned APP and respective learned advocates.

entities.text: Narendra Balkrushna Vyas vs Manibhai Mulchanddas Patel
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
4. It is submitted that the offence alleged against the accused under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, is not serious in nature, the penalty / punishment prescribed for such offence is not substantial in view of the Sections 51 and 52 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, it is compoundable under Section 69 of the said Act.
5.
In view of the withdrawal / compromise pursis of the parties, this Appeal stands disposed of.
The respondents No. 1 to 4 are directed to pay a sum of Rs.3,000/- (Rupees Three Thousand Only) each.
In all, the respondents no. 1 to 4 shall pay Rs. 12,000/- towards litigation cost; as agreed between the parties.
Necessary cost be deposited in the office of the High Court Legal Services Committee within four weeks, failing which the Appeal shall stand revived automatically.
Accordingly, this appeal stands disposed of.

6. However, disposal of this matter will not affect any connected R/CR.A/1009/2017 ORDER matters arising out of the same, incidental or any other proceedings, filed or to be filed before any other Court.
It is also required to be noted that this order will not be treated as a precedent in any future case for reference.

(B.N. KARIA, J.) Chairman ksdarji Narendra Balkrushna Vyas vs Manibhai Mulchanddas Patel on 22 April, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185607876/
